_comment: Paste ONLY the mcpServers block below into Cline > MCP Servers > Configure (cline_mcp_settings.json) — Cline ignores this documentation key. Option A (Docker, the live entry) runs the exact image CI builds from this repository — recommended, pinned to mcp-server/package.json (scripts/check-version-sync.mjs validates it). Option B (npm channel, below in _alternative_npx) needs no Docker: replace the docker entry's command/args with the npx ones. Use ONE, not both.

_alternative_npx.note: npm release channel (latest actually published to npm). The Docker entry is the repo-exact audited build (1.15.0); npm publishes trail Docker. Keep the version pinned — @latest may drift from the audited tree.
